titration-setup.alt: A buret clamped on a stand above an Erlenmeyer flask. The buret holds the titrant of known molarity and has been rinsed with titrant; a stopcock at its bottom controls the flow, dropwise near the end. The flask holds a measured volume of analyte plus a few drops of indicator and is swirled while titrant is added. An inset shows the curved liquid surface in the buret with a dashed line at its lowest point: read the bottom of the meniscus at eye level.
